title: discovery: mailbox_host from peer apiUrl not validated against Tailscale identity
description: In discovery.rs run_discovery_round(), the peer's owner_user_id (from the JMAP session response) is cross-validated against WhoIs at line 404: ps.owner_user_id == whois_user_id. However, ps.mailbox_host is extracted from the peer's apiUrl field (line 398-401) and stored verbatim as contact.mailbox_host without any equivalent Tailscale identity check. A peer can return an arbitrary apiUrl (e.g. pointing to a different tailnet node) that passes the SSRF guard in is_valid_fetch_host, causing all outbound deliveries for that contact to be routed to a different node than the one that Tailscale authenticated. The fix is to derive mailbox_host directly from the WhoIs-confirmed peer IP (peer_ip in the probe task) rather than trusting the peer-supplied apiUrl hostname.
